name: test-interactive-codegen
description: Test E2E du mode interactif: analyse (non-interactive) → code (interactive) → tests (interactive). Vérifie la création de fichiers réels, le git diff tracking, et la consolidation.

phases.name: Design
phases.description: Analyze the task requirements and produce a detailed technical design. List the files to create, the data structures, and the function signatures. Do NOT create any files — output text only.

phases.name: Code
phases.description: Implement the code based on the Design phase output. Create all necessary source files on disk. Follow TypeScript conventions, add JSDoc comments, and ensure the code compiles.

phases.name: Tests
phases.description: Write comprehensive unit tests for the code created in the Code phase. Use vitest. Create test files on disk and run them to verify they pass.
